scan_result: The contents and full-text term scan identify three bowl-relevant contributions: Abudraham's Miami bowl re-edition, Morgenstern's bowl-based linguistic study, and Ford's Davidovitz 41 edition. The remaining contributions concern other Hebrew, Aramaic, biblical, Samaritan, and Syriac linguistic subjects and were not added to the bowl scholarship index.
